numberingPolicy: Game numbers are global observation samples. Hall order does not force a numeric range; each hall can hold 11 official playable experiments.
slotVariantRunPolicy: The 99 game slots represent 99 observation samples, not 99 AI generations. A single game may contain multiple model variants and run records. Model comparisons are stored as variants/runs under the same game slot and do not consume additional game numbers.

halls.name: Arcade Reaction Hall
halls.description: Observes AI ability in feedback, timing, input feel, difficulty curves, and short-loop clarity.

halls.name: Puzzle Logic Hall
halls.description: Observes AI ability in rules, constraints, state logic, solvability, and puzzle communication.

halls.name: Survival Strategy Hall
halls.description: Observes AI ability in resource pressure, route planning, risk feedback, and tactical systems.

halls.name: Card Strategy Hall
halls.description: Observes AI ability in probabilistic decisions, drafting, turn structure, and readable strategy.

halls.name: Text Adventure Hall
halls.description: Observes AI ability in branching narrative, state memory, tone, and meaningful choices.

halls.name: Clicker Management Hall
halls.description: Observes AI ability in economies, automation loops, scaling, and player motivation.

halls.name: Physics Experiment Hall
halls.description: Observes AI ability in simulation feel, spatial reasoning, cause/effect, and sandbox tuning.

halls.name: Rhythm Audio Hall
halls.description: Observes AI ability in timing windows, pattern memory, audio feedback, and input precision.

halls.name: AI Meme Hall
halls.description: Observes AI ability in self-reference, humor, weird failure modes, and playful systems.
